result.review: Corrected deep-history source admission and measurement-boundary review
result.scope: Read-only source/hash review. No builds, pilot, controls, benchmarks or runtime tests executed.

premise.quote:
Give competing arms the same observable task and meaningful success checks.
  Validate intermediate results when timing intermediate operations. Endpoint
  agreement does not certify every timed write.

closedCorrections.finding: Individual valid hashes could mix a plan with another package or mutable config.
closedCorrections.correction: Archive integrity and source seal now join the exact plan artifact; config commit joins plan.sourceHead; consumed installed bytes match archive; config hash is rechecked at controller and child admission.

closedCorrections.finding: A first-subject identity sample and endpoint contradiction did not certify all historical facets.
closedCorrections.correction: Every aging ID receives five exact weak identity tokens before first drain, full primitive ready role/cell/flag snapshots afterward, and exact pending transaction cell identity/outcome checks. Complete history is rechecked around later work.

closedCorrections.finding: Repeated cached public snapshots did not establish whole-source capture cost.
closedCorrections.correction: Public snapshot path is labeled using observed visits; a separately named actual source.captureInput phase requires two physical views per retired ID per call and complete role union.

closedCorrections.finding: Fresh timed bulk omitted new terminal facts from later coverage.
closedCorrections.correction: Every fresh ID receives five postdrain ready facts, actual prior pending destination with rolled-back outcome, and complete generic capture coverage. New reference baseline is explicitly postdrain-only.

closedCorrections.finding: Silent late Link construction alone could be vacuous behavior evidence.
closedCorrections.correction: Two untimed late Links perform literal row installations inside current-native-input scope, require receipt/contradiction plus exact delivery, clear/reseed and recheck prior facts.

sourceAssessment: No further source blocker demonstrated to the registered pilot and controls.

Same-source late updater does not erase its nested row installation via its empty partial return: updateAndReport consumes native input around updater invocation and applies only supplied partial keys afterward (signal-tree.ts 2134-2161). This supports plausibility, not execution of the new oracle.
Each measured sample is a fresh process, arms rotate/reverse within profile trios, phases have explicit boundaries, and failures stop the cohort while preserving raw output.

Primitive oracle tables, held handles and before snapshots contribute to whole heap; aging includes diagnostics. The protocol states these limitations and transient deltas are not peak/allocation metrics.

remainingFalsifiers.test: Registered baseline pilot must execute the same-source late updater and establish exactly one installed/delivered row with independent contradiction and unknown surviving receipt.
Registered three semantic controls must reject skipped population, early output and bypassed native input at their exact intended oracles.
Admission controls can substitute a valid wrong-arm plan/archive pair or change the frozen config; new equality checks must reject before measurement.
Final comparisons must complete every preregistered cell and preserve first failures before any performance interpretation.

limits: This is permission-independent review, not release qualification or an adoption verdict.
No timing, memory reduction, cross-arm equality or late-oracle runtime result is established by this receipt.
Fresh bulk reference identity is checked only after drain; aging references are checked across drain.
Five samples per arm/profile support bounded distributions only.
